title: Learning to Formalize: Bridging Open-Ended Workloads and Fast Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36595v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision models offer fast choices over sup- plied alternatives, while general-purpose large language models interpret open-ended tasks through flexible generation and reasoning at the cost of sequential decoding. Many work- loads expect a generative backend to determine what can be done and therefore provide no well-defined candidate list. We bridge this in- terface gap with a small candidate formalizer trained on offline teacher-generated lists. The formalizer constructs explicit, validated alter- natives from task context, and a frozen deci- sion model selects an entry. translated_title: 学习形式化：连接开放式工作负载与快速决策模型
translated_abstract: 决策模型能够在提供的候选项之间快速做出选择，而通用大型语言模型则通过灵活的生成与推理来解读开放式任务，但代价是顺序解码带来的高延迟。许多工作负载期望由生成式后端来确定可以执行哪些操作，因此并未提供明确定义的候选列表。我们通过一个在离线教师生成的列表上训练的小型候选形式化器来弥合这一接口差距。该形式化器从任务上下文中构建显式的、经过验证的备选方案，再由冻结的决策模型从中选择一个条目。在一项动机性对比实验中，在200个CALVIN-D测试回合上与官方TypeSafe Jev-1.13.0进行比较，使用通用动作的成功率为11%，而使用DeepSeek V4 Flash位姿候选的成功率为46.5%。此外，在1,011个CALVIN-D验证标注上进行的一项六臂特权状态评估发现，本地部署的决策模型最多可达到52.6%的任务成功率
tldr: 提出一个在离线教师生成列表上训练的小型候选形式化器，将开放式任务上下文转化为显式且经验证的候选项，使冻结的快速决策模型能够取代缓慢的生成式大模型后端完成高效选择。
en_tdlr: A small candidate formalizer trained on offline teacher-generated lists converts open-ended task contexts into explicit, validated alternatives, enabling a frozen fast decision model to replace slow generative LLM backends for efficient selection.
